faq: Will PHP become a compiled language?

Partly. AOT compilers like elephc and TypePHP already compile a typed subset of PHP to native code, mainly for extensions and tools. Regular interpreted PHP will remain the default for frameworks for the foreseeable future.
Is native PHP just HHVM again?
No. HHVM tried to replace the PHP runtime. elephc and TypePHP are designed to work alongside standard PHP, for example by compiling modules into extensions that stock PHP loads.
When will TypePHP be production ready?
A May 2026 talk on Swoole's AOT compiler targeted general availability for May 2027. As of November 2026 the project describes itself as under active development.
Is NativePHP the future of PHP mobile development?
It is the most credible path for Laravel teams as of 2026, with an MIT core and native UI via SuperNative. Its long-term reach depends on how broad its plugin ecosystem becomes.
